content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a use-after-free condition in the xHCI driver when handling the clearing of the hub transaction translator (TT) buffer. This occurred because the xHCI driver scheduled work to clear the TT buffer while the USB core was simultaneously freeing and reallocating a new device for the next enumeration attempt. If the endpoint was disabled before the clearing work was completed, it would lead to dereferencing already freed pointers related to the endpoint and device, resulting in undefined behavior. The fix involved ensuring that the clearing work was completed before the endpoint was disabled, similar to the behavior implemented in the EHCI driver.
